sources.claim: Autoprotolysis is proton transfer between chemically identical molecules, acting as acid and base.
Water autoprotolysis constant is the hydronium/hydroxide activity product, 1e-14 at 25 Celsius.
pH is defined from hydrogen-ion activity; supplied concentration normalization is an approximation.
The Henderson-Hasselbalch logarithmic ratio gives the equivalent acid/base orientation used in the cases.
